title: 網路與社群
description: 上網與社群媒體的用語

sentences.en: What's the wifi password?
sentences.zh: WiFi 密碼是什麼？

sentences.en: I just posted a photo on Instagram.
sentences.zh: 我剛在 Instagram 上發了一張照片。

sentences.en: Can you share this link with me?
sentences.zh: 你可以把這個連結分享給我嗎？

sentences.en: I started following that account yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我昨天開始追蹤那個帳號了。

sentences.en: Did you see the comments on that post?
sentences.zh: 你有看到那則貼文的留言嗎？

sentences.en: I liked your photo on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我在 Facebook 上按了你照片的讚。

sentences.en: That video is trending right now.
sentences.zh: 那個影片現在正在流行。

sentences.en: The internet connection is really unstable.
sentences.zh: 網路連線很不穩定。

sentences.en: I unfollowed a bunch of accounts.
sentences.zh: 我取消追蹤了一堆帳號。

sentences.en: He went viral overnight.
sentences.zh: 他一夜之間爆紅了。

sentences.en: I got a friend request from someone I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我收到一個不認識的人的好友邀請。

sentences.en: Can you tag me in that photo?
sentences.zh: 你可以在那張照片裡標記我嗎？

sentences.en: I updated my profile picture.
sentences.zh: 我更新了我的大頭貼。

sentences.en: The page keeps loading and won't open.
sentences.zh: 這個頁面一直在載入，打不開。

sentences.en: I bookmarked that website for later.
sentences.zh: 我把那個網站加入書籤了。

sentences.en: Don't click on suspicious links.
sentences.zh: 不要點擊可疑的連結。

sentences.en: I watch a lot of content on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 我在 YouTube 上看很多內容。

sentences.en: My account got hacked.
sentences.zh: 我的帳號被駭了。

sentences.en: I changed my privacy settings.
sentences.zh: 我更改了我的隱私設定。

sentences.en: How many followers do you have?
sentences.zh: 你有多少追蹤者？

sentences.en: I muted that group chat.
sentences.zh: 我把那個群組靜音了。

sentences.en: The wifi signal is too weak in this room.
sentences.zh: 這個房間的 WiFi 訊號太弱了。

sentences.en: I reported that account for spam.
sentences.zh: 我檢舉了那個帳號的垃圾訊息。

sentences.en: Let me send you the link in a direct message.
sentences.zh: 讓我用私訊把連結傳給你。

sentences.en: I subscribed to that channel.
sentences.zh: 我訂閱了那個頻道。

sentences.en: The hashtag is getting a lot of attention.
sentences.zh: 這個 hashtag 很受關注。

sentences.en: I deleted my old social media account.
sentences.zh: 我刪掉了我舊的社群媒體帳號。

sentences.en: My feed is full of ads.
sentences.zh: 我的動態牆都是廣告。

sentences.en: I shared that article on my story.
sentences.zh: 我把那篇文章分享到限時動態了。

sentences.en: Can you connect to the hotspot from my phone?
sentences.zh: 你可以連接我手機的熱點嗎？
